Audit, manage, and clean up feature flags across codebases to reduce toggle debt

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Feature Toggle Manager – a skill to audit, manage, and clean up feature flags across codebases.

- Automates discovery and classification of feature flags from popular systems (LaunchDarkly, Unleash, env vars, custom).
- Provides audit reports with staleness detection, orphan/phantom flag checks, and toggle debt scoring.
- Generates safe, step-by-step cleanup plans for stale or fully rolled out feature flags.
- Maps lifecycle management for new toggles, including rollout stages and best practices.
- Supplies ready-to-use command templates for inventory, assessment, and cleanup operations.
